title: Mar of Mashkhei
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Menachot 43a](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.43a.4) relates that he brought tekhelet, blue-dyed wool, in Rav Achai's time. [Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Menachot.43a.4.1-2) explains that his name was Mar and he came from Mashkha; [Kiddushin 72a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.72a.7) likewise has the form Mushkhei.[^1][^2]

notes.text: Rashi glosses Mar as a sage’s name and mi-Mashkhei as a place-name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2413&lang=en) makes the same distinction.
Kiddushin distinguishes Mushkhei from Mushkenei. Hyman points to Mushkhei as a parallel spelling.
